pr_body: Signed-off-by: Yu Juncen ### What problem does this PR solve? Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/30425 Problem Summary: The API `ScatterRegion` did nothing when failed to create the operator due to unhealthy regions. Hence the failed requests can neither be retried by BR(BR has no way to check whether the operator is finished or dropped) nor retied internally by PD. After this PR, we would use `ScatterRegions` if possible. This can reduce the failure of operator creation. ### What is changed and how it works? ### Check List Tests - [x] Unit test - [x] Manual test (TBD) (Tested it at v4.0.16 cluster, it can scatter region properly.) ### Release note ```release-note Fix a bug that might cause unbalanced region after restoration. ```
